## Markup

```html
<!-- Player bar: play toggle, meta, progress. Fill width and aria-valuenow track position. -->
<div class="uifa-player">
  <button type="button" data-uifa-slot="play" aria-label="Play">▶</button>
  <div data-uifa-slot="meta">
    <span data-uifa-slot="title">Episode title</span>
    <span data-uifa-slot="time">0:00 / 35:00</span>
  </div>
  <div data-uifa-slot="progress" role="progressbar" aria-label="Playback position" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="0">
    <span data-uifa-slot="progress-fill" style="width: 0%"></span>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Usage

Reader-style player bar. The play control announces Play/Pause via `aria-label`; position lives on the `[data-uifa-slot="progress"]` element (`role="progressbar"` with value attributes) and its fill width mirrors `aria-valuenow`. The example script simulates playback; point the same hooks at a real `<audio>` element to consume it.
